nom: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Fragrance-Free Gel Facial Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-to-oily skin describe the gel as cleansing thoroughly without feeling gunky, greasy, or leaving skin oily, and one notes it helped with acne-prone skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin most commonly report the cleanser hydrates and softens without stripping, though one reviewer with dry skin found it made her skin drier over time and another advises very dry skin may need a richer option.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including one describing combination leaning dry and one combination-to-oily, report the gel is gentle, non-stripping, and suits their skin well.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers repeatedly report no irritation, redness, tightness, or breakouts, praising the fragrance-free formula, though one notes it does not remove heavy waterproof makeup well.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal or normal-to-dry/oily skin report it cleanses effectively while keeping skin hydrated and comfortable for daily use.
segments.mature: One reviewer with combination, 50+ skin reports it has worked well for years, and another self-described as sensitive and 'starting to age' with dehydrated skin reports no irritation or breakouts.

concerns.aging: The few reviewers who mention aging or mature skin report the cleanser works well long-term and does not irritate; no anti-aging effect is claimed.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describing dehydrated or dry skin report visible improvement in hydration, softness and plumpness after use; one dissenting reviewer with dry skin reports it made her skin drier over time.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness or easily irritated skin report the cleanser reduced or avoided redness and itchiness, with no reports of increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers concerned with a compromised or reactive skin barrier, including those using drying treatments like Epiduo, report the cleanser does not strip or worsen their barrier.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the cleanser helped with an ongoing breakout without worsening it, and another with acne-prone combination-oily skin reports it helped her acne; no reviewer reports new breakouts from spots specifically.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers state the product is non-comedogenic and hasn't caused breakouts; no reviewer reports the cleanser causing new blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report it cleanses excess oil effectively without leaving skin greasy or stripped.

aspects.libelle: Struggles with heavy or waterproof makeup

extraits.texte: I have been using this since a few months, i have dry skin and i have realized that it makes my skin drier. However it is still a good face wash overall.

extraits.titre: I use it for my dry skin it helps me a lot
extraits.texte: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Water Gel is an excellent daily moisturizer if you need lightweight hydration with a refreshing feel. It's perfect for normal to oily skin and works well under makeup. If you have very dry or sensitive skin, you might need a fragrance-free or richer option.

extraits.titre: As a dry skin girl, I love it so far!
extraits.texte: I'm 27, have naturally dry/fairly untextured skin, and I don't have acne but my skin does have breakouts that can last days/weeks to over a month. I currently have a breakout and decided to try this since I ran out of cleanser and most Neutrogena products work amazingly for my skin. It's been a week and I love it - my skin feels clean and soft after using it, without it completely stripping my face. It also hasn't worsened my current breakout in anyway. Exactly what I wanted. If your skin type sounds like mine I'd recommend this.

I honestly didn't expect to love this as much as I do, but the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Cleansing Gel has become a staple in my skincare routine. I have very dry, sensitive skin that usually feels tight or irritated after washing—but this cleanser is different. It's lightweight, gentle, and leaves my face feeling clean without stripping it. The texture is super smooth and turns into a soft lather that feels refreshing. It removes dirt, oil, and even light makeup while keeping my skin hydrated thanks to the hyaluronic acid. There's no overpowering scent, and I love that it's fragrance-free and non-comedogenic—no breakouts, no tightness, just healthy, dewy skin. Best of all? It's totally affordable, especially compared to other hydrating cleansers. A little goes a long way, and it's been worth every penny. If you deal with dryness or irritation, give this a try—you won't regret it.

I've been using a different cleanser for years and my skin always felt dehydrated after. I started using the Neutrogena Hydroboost Hydrating Gel Cleanser about a month ago, and let me tell you, I love it! It foams up nicely and removes all my makeup, including mascara. The first time I used it, my skin felt super soft after. It didn't have that tight feeling I had with my old cleanser. I have sensitive, starting to age, dehydrated skin and it has not irritated my skin or broke me out.

I absolutely love how lightweight the gel texture feels on my skin; it's super refreshing and doesn't leave that tight, "squeaky clean" feeling that usually means your skin is stripped of moisture. Since it's fragrance-free, it's a total win for my sensitive skin and hasn't caused any breakouts or irritation at all. The hyaluronic acid definitely helps keep things plump and hydrated during the wash. However, if I'm being honest, it's not the best at removing heavy waterproof makeup 💄. I usually have to go in with a cleansing balm first because this cleanser alone doesn't quite get all the stubborn mascara off. Also, I noticed I have to use a couple of pumps to get a good lather going, so I might go through the bottle faster than I'd like. Overall, it's a fantastic, reliable daily cleanser for keeping your skin barrier happy, especially if you have dry or sensitive skin, but just don't expect it to be a heavy duty makeup remover! it's definitely earned a permanent spot in my morning routine though.

I have been using this product for a while now and I absolutely love it. I like how it cleans my pores and deeply gets in there. I'm combination to oily skin and I feel like this best suits my skin and has helped with my acne problems scan as well.
